verdict.rationale: Clerk documents a first-party Next.js integration (clerk-docs-19) and a JavaScript SDK repo (clerk-gh-1); its CLI detects the framework and adds auth files (clerk-docs-37), and a community user praises the Next.js integration (clerk-comm-15). Short-lived JWT session tokens are documented for authenticating backend requests (clerk-docs-6, clerk-docs-22), but the pack never shows route-protection middleware or session verification at the edge. missing for 10: documented route-protection middleware, edge-runtime session verification, named peer-framework SDKs beyond Next.js, independent hands-on corroboration of route protection.
